in_sanskrit.name: Ejajul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ejajul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ejajul is derived from the Sanskrit language and means 'God's Grace'. This name is often given to babies as a sign of blessings from the divine. It is believed that the child named Ejajul will be protected and guided by the gods throughout their life.
